statement: The exact Sobolev endpoint for Schrödinger convergence. Proves almost-everywhere convergence $`e^{it\Delta}f\to f`$ as $`t\downarrow0`$ for every $`f\in H^{n/(2(n+1))}(\mathbb R^n)`$ and every dimension n ≥ 2. This attains the sharp Sobolev equality case of Carleson's Schrödinger convergence problem, including the planar endpoint H1/3.
